dashboard.flowMissing: Some power values are unavailable; the flow appears again once the device reports.
dashboard.negativeLoad: Home load reads {value}; shown as 0 W, likely a metering error. Check the wiring if it persists.
dashboard.signs: Battery **+ = discharging, − = charging**; grid **+ = importing, − = exporting**.
dashboard.modePending: Mode switching for this inverter is still being added by its maker; modes cannot be changed here yet.
dashboard.remoteNote: Enter a **positive power** and duration in **minutes**, then press Start. Editing the draft does not change the device or a running task. TOU must be exited first. Enable the new entities on the device page. Heartbeats run internally; the current timeout is 60 s with self-consumption as the fallback (firmware validation pending).
dashboard.controlsOff: Controls are off. Enable **Allow control** in the integration options to change EMS mode, SOC limits and remote dispatch.
dashboard.noDevice: No EnergyLIB device found. Add the EnergyLIB integration first.
dashboard.powerConfirm: Switch the inverter on or off? When off, PV and the battery stop; without the grid the home loses power.
dashboard.offlineHelp: Check the inverter's power and network; this page updates once it is back.
dashboard.sourceNote: Sources estimated from grid import and battery discharge
dashboard.modeLocked: {mode} is in control; the mode can be changed once it ends.

modeDesc.self_consumption: Solar powers the home first, then charges the battery, then exports.
modeDesc.time_of_use: Charges or discharges in the time-of-use periods; for peak and off-peak tariffs.
modeDesc.backup: Keeps the battery full, also from the grid: use it before a power cut.
modeDesc.pv_charge_priority: Solar charges the battery first; the home runs from the grid.
modeDesc.feed_in_priority: Solar powers the home, exports the surplus, and charges the battery last.
modeDesc.peak_shaving: Uses the battery to cut peaks in grid use, as set on the device.

dashboard.errTime: The end must be after the start (no period across midnight: split it in two).
dashboard.errPower: Power must be between 0 and {max} kW.
dashboard.errCount: At most {count} charge and {count} discharge periods.
dashboard.touRemote: Manual control is running; the plan can be changed once it ends.
dashboard.energySetup: Add this inverter to the Energy dashboard to see day, week, month and year statistics
dashboard.dayAria: Today from midnight, power in kW

sankey.title: Live power distribution
sankey.unavailable: Power data is incomplete. Waiting for device readings.
sankey.invalid: Negative solar or home load reading. Check device metering.
sankey.note: Live power, not daily energy. Ribbon widths show power on one scale. The bus combines sources; individual source-to-load allocations are not measured.
sankey.imbalance: Meter difference is the input/output mismatch. It may include timing differences or losses; its cause is unconfirmed.

alarms.title: Device alerts
alarms.note: Times are HA observations, not the device event time.

dispatch.title: Forced battery charge / discharge
dispatch.note: Settings take effect when you press Start.
dispatch.runningNote: Edits do not change this task. Press Start again to apply them.
dispatch.invalid: Enter positive power and a whole duration of 1–1440 minutes.
dispatch.tou: Time-of-use is active. Exit it before manual operation.
dispatch.unavailable: Device or operation settings unavailable. Check the connection.
dispatch.offNote: Enable to restore operation entities; press Start to run a task.
dispatch.onNote: Operation entities enabled. Disabling first stops any active task.
dispatch.syncing: Enabling operation entities. Wait for Home Assistant to load them before starting a task.
dispatch.controlsOff: Control access is off. Enable Allow control in the integration options; remote charge/discharge still requires its separate opt-in.
